PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Server-side engineer with six years building JavaScript services on the V8
runtime for payments and ticketing platforms. Designs HTTP/JSON APIs,
models data in document-oriented databases, and ships containerised
services through automated pipelines. Values boring, observable systems
that page nobody at night.

SKILLS
- Languages: server-side JavaScript (V8 runtime), TypeScript
- Services: HTTP/JSON API design, middleware-based web frameworks,

- Data: document-oriented databases (Mongo), aggregation pipelines,

- Delivery: OCI container images, compose-based local stacks, blue-green

- Practices: JWT authentication, idempotency keys, contract checks,
  structured logging

EXPERIENCE

Senior Software Engineer — Marina Bay Payments, Chennai
May 2020 to April 2025
- Owned the settlement APIs: JavaScript services on the V8 runtime
  handling 30k requests per minute with p95 under 120ms.
- Modelled settlement ledgers in a document-oriented database; designed
  aggregation pipelines powering reconciliation reports.
- Added an in-memory key-value caching layer with write-through
  invalidation; database read load fell 60%.
- Packaged all nine services as OCI container images with health-check
  driven blue-green deploys; rollback time fell to minutes.
- Introduced idempotency keys on payment webhooks; duplicate settlement
  incidents went to zero.

Software Engineer — Coromandel Ticketing Systems, Chennai

- Implemented JWT-based authentication shared by three client apps.
